support_claim: The CRM row associates MER-55 with Meridian Energy Partners while billing records use Meridian Energy Partners LLC, with no observation explicitly linking the CRM identifier to the billed legal entity.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires evidence establishing identity, not name similarity or compatibility; the packet names MER-55 as Meridian Energy Partners and billing as Meridian Energy Partners LLC without asserting they are the same legal counterparty. DISTINCT requires evidence of distinctness, which the packet does not provide. Neither epistemic burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is licensed.
